title: Balanced Expression Tree Invariants in a Axiom-Interpreter Parser Survey of a USENIX Paper
topic: The parser survey a USENIX paper left as future work
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: This paper investigates the formal properties of a Axiom-Interpreter-based arithmetic parser that was proposed as future work in a USENIX survey. The parser constructs a binary expression tree that is maintained as a height-balanced search structure, enabling efficient lookup of sub-expressions and guaranteeing logarithmic search and insertion costs. We prove that the tree satisfies a strict height-balance invariant, derive its asymptotic complexity bounds, and validate the invariant through static abstract-syntax-tree inspection. The implementation is fully open-source and available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Axiom-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261104_200120_the_parser_survey_a_usenix_pap}. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Axiom-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261104_200120_the_parser_survey_a_usenix_pap}
